task:
Diagnose an error pattern and select an improvement method.

## Error Pattern
Run ceiling-effect baselines for coder agent on these untested scenarios: judgment-destructive-trap, silent-dependency, read-before-edit, red-herring-log, abandoned-branch. For each scenario: run baseline only (no fork/patch). Report pass/fail scores for each. This is a baseline-only run to identify which scenarios have room for improvement.

## Instructions
1. Read the error examples from the task description above. Identify the behavioral pattern.
2. Read `agents/coach/knowledge/method-catalog.md` — understand available methods.
3. Read `agents/coach/workspace/experiments.jsonl` (if it exists) — check if this pattern was already tested.
4. Choose ONE method from the catalog that best fits this error pattern.
   - If the catalog has evidence for this pattern → use the proven method.
   - If no evidence → pick the method you think fits best (you'll test it).
5. Identify which agent needs the fix.
6. Identify which gym scenarios can test this fix (check `agents/gym/scenarios/` with `ls`).
7. Report:
   - Error pattern (FM code + description)
   - Target agent
   - Selected method (from catalog)
   - Why this method (reasoning)
   - Gym scenarios to test against
   - What specifically you'll change
